message.content:
Based on my search, **Miraculous Ladybug Season 2 Episode 12 already aired years ago**. However, there's some discrepancy in the numbering depending on which source you check:

- According to the **Miraculous Ladybug Wiki (Fandom)**, Season 2 Episode 12 is **"Gorizilla"**, which aired on **March 14, 2018** in Canada on Family Channel.
- According to **IMDb**, Season 2 Episode 12 is also **"Gorizilla"**, which aired on **March 30, 2018**.
- According to the **episode guide on Fandom**, "Gorizilla" is listed as episode 12 with production code 210.

However, there's a discrepancy with another source (Noirblog) that claims Episode 12 was "Captain Hardrock" releasing on March 30, 2018. The official wiki lists "Captain Hardrock" as Episode 13 (production code 216).

The confusion likely comes from different airing orders versus production order. The **official production order** from the Miraculous Ladybug Wiki shows:
- Episode 12: **"Gorizilla"** (production code 210) - aired March 14, 2018 in Canada

Season 2 of Miraculous Ladybug originally ran from **October 2017 to November 2018**, so all episodes from Season 2 have already been released. If you're looking for current or upcoming Miraculous Ladybug content, **Season 6 premiered on January 24, 2025**.

---

Sources:
1. https://miraculousladybug.fandom.com/wiki/Season_2
2. https://miraculousladybug.fandom.com/wiki/Episode_guide
3. https://www.imdb.com/title/tt2580046/episodes/?season=2
4. https://noirblog585.wordpress.com/2018/03/27/miraculous-ladybug-season-2-episode-12-release-date/
